title: Chen Nian Returns
next_chapter_hook: Chen Nian hands Chen Ji a Turtle Shell Fragment, claiming it to be the true source of the Chen family bloodline—the patterns on this fragment are exactly the same as the sealing marks on the Tianji Record Fragment.

text.content: The Guardian's words still echoed in his ears, and Chen Ji had yet to recover from that sentence 'The true Chess Player has already appeared,' when a figure suddenly tore through the smoke of battle without warning. Torn robes wrapped around a gaunt frame, waist-length hair stained with dark brown bloodstains, that face pale as paper yet carrying a familiar stubborn angle—it's Chen Nian. His younger sister, the girl he thought had long died, stood before him with an almost obstinate stance.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. This girl before him was completely different from the little one in his memory who would chase after him calling 'big brother'—her eye sockets were sunken, cheekbones protruding, the faint blue veins visible beneath her skin spoke of some unimaginable drain. The only thing unchanged was the light always burning in those eyes, the light that refused to surrender.

dialogue.content: (Voice hoarse) How... how did your body end up like this?

text.content: Chen Nian smiled, that smile weak yet gentle, like a wick in winter about to extinguish yet still stubbornly burning. She raised her hand, those slender fingers almost transparent pointing to her own heart, where a dark golden pattern faintly flickered, exactly matching the sealing marks on Chen Ji's Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: The faked death plan... the price I paid was far greater than you imagined. The Holy Sect extracted my lifespan to inject into the Tianji Record, just to buy you three days of freedom. Ten years, a full ten years... but it was worth it.

text.content: Chen Ji felt something violently churning in his chest, an emotion he had never shown before anyone. Ten years of lifespan—his sister's ten years of life, a debt he could never repay. His fist clenched tightly within his sleeve, knuckles white from the force, yet his facial expression maintained the usual numbness of a talentless disciple.

dialogue.content: (Pressing down his voice, barely containing his emotions) Why... why didn't you tell me in advance?

text.content: Chen Nian shook her head, those eyes identical to Chen Ji's flickering with a light he had never seen before—the clarity of one who has seen through the world, and a maturity beyond her years. She walked closer slowly, each step seemingly draining her remaining life force, yet she walked with absolute determination.

dialogue.content: Because if you knew, you wouldn't use it. You, this person... you talk about calculating the world, yet in your heart you always place family outside your calculations. Brother, did you think I didn't know?

text.content: This sentence was like an invisible blade, precisely piercing through Chen Ji's seemingly impenetrable heart. A crack finally appeared in his expression, that talentless mask seeming ready to crumble. He drew a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the churning emotions, his voice becoming low and dangerous.

dialogue.content: ...I remember. When this matter is concluded, I will return those ten years that belong to you. No matter what the cost.

text.content: Chen Nian looked at him, tears glistening in her eyes, yet they never fell. She knew her brother—that man who appeared talentless on the surface yet calculated everything without exception—was telling the truth right now. His promises were always oaths exchanged with his life.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian appears to reveal the truth, Chen Ji faces his sister's sacrifice of ten years of lifespan, emotions churning within him. He chooses:

choices.description: Temporarily seal Chen Nian in a safe place, preventing her from continuing to consume her life force
choices.risk_hint: May anger Chen Nian, damaging brother-sister rapport

text.content: A decisive light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, and he struck abruptly, his fingertip condensing a dark golden rune that directly pointed to Chen Nian's Brow Center. That rune was a forbidden technique recorded in the Tianji Record—a technique he never imagined he would one day use on his own sister. Chen Nian's pupils dilated sharply, wanting to evade but it was already too late.

dialogue.content: Brother! You... (Voice abruptly cutting off, Chen Nian's body slowly fell, caught by Chen Ji)

choices.text: Inquire about the Blood Pulse truth
choices.description: Question the origin of the identical mark on her body with the Tianji Record, this is key to solving the mystery
choices.visible_reward: Obtain important information about the Blood Pulse
choices.risk_hint: May delay treating Chen Nian's timing

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Emotions could exist, but one must not let emotions dominate judgment. He carefully examined the dark golden pattern over Chen Nian's heart—the design matched the sealing marks on the Tianji Record Fragment exactly, yet there were subtle differences—as if they were different branches of the same tree.

dialogue.content: This mark... is exactly the same as the seal on the Tianji Record. Little Nian, how do you have this? These ten years... what exactly have you been through?

choices.text: Activate Shared Life buff to share consumption
choices.description: Attempt to activate Su Qingyao's Shared Life buff, sharing the lifespan consumption with Chen Nian (Su Qingyao must be present)
choices.visible_reward: May restore some of Chen Nian's lifespan
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao is not present, this option is invalid

text.content: A thought suddenly flashed through Chen Ji's mind—Su Qingyao's Shared Life buff. There existed some peculiar connection between him and this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow; if he could extend this connection to Chen Nian, perhaps he could share the lifespan that had been stripped from her. But he needed Su Qingyao present, needed her cooperation.

dialogue.content: (Low voice) Little Nian, how long can you hold on? Where is Su Qingyao?

text.content: The sounds of killing on the battlefield seemed separated into another world. At this moment, Chen Ji's eyes held only this thin girl before him; those carefully woven chess games, those flawless calculations, all became unimportant at this moment. His sister had returned—the reunion bought with ten years of lifespan.

dialogue.content: Brother... don't blame yourself. This was my choice. All our lives, you've been protecting me... this time, let me protect you.

text.content: Chen Ji's eye sockets faintly reddened, but he quickly concealed that trace of vulnerability. He gently brushed the stray hair from Chen Nian's forehead, the movement so gentle as if fearing to disturb a wounded butterfly. Beneath that talentless exterior, a cold heart was undergoing some subtle change.

dialogue.content: (Low voice) Silly girl... who asked you to protect me. Your life is mine; those ten years I owe, I will personally retrieve. The Holy Sect... I've taken note.

text.content: Hearing these words, a weak smile curved Chen Nian's lips. She knew once her brother spoke like this, the Holy Sect had already been added to his list of must-kill targets. That outwardly timid talentless junior disciple—what terrifying hatred he concealed in the depths of his heart, only she knew best.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian takes out a Turtle Shell Fragment from her bosom, the truth of the Blood Pulse about to be revealed. Chen Ji decides:

choices.text: Immediately examine the Turtle Shell Fragment
choices.description: Take the fragment and study it carefully; the secret of the Blood Pulse may relate to the truth of the entire chess game
choices.visible_reward: Unlock important clues about the origin of the bloodline

text.content: Chen Ji took the Turtle Shell Fragment, and the moment it touched his palm, a strange resonance traveled from his palm. The patterns on the fragment were ancient and mysterious, exactly the same as the sealing marks on the Tianji Record Fragment, yet upon closer inspection there were subtle differences—as if this was some more ancient source.

choices.description: The fragment can be studied later; the most important thing now is to preserve Chen Nian's life
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian's condition may not allow her to hold on much longer

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Turtle Shell Fragment into his breast, his gaze returning to Chen Nian's pale face. Her breathing grew fainter and fainter, her life force visibly draining away. He had to stabilize her condition first; those secrets could wait, but his sister's life could not.

At this moment, Chen Nian suddenly grabbed Chen Ji's wrist, using all her strength to shove the Turtle Shell Fragment into his palm. Her fingers were ice-cold, yet she gripped with absolute determination.

dialogue.content: Brother... this is the true source of the Chen family bloodline. The Holy Sect has been searching for it since we were children. I... I kept it for them for ten years. Now... now it should return to its rightful owner.

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the Turtle Shell Fragment in his palm; the ancient patterns actually emitted a faint dark golden glow the moment it touched him. At the same time, he felt the Tianji Record violently trembling in his Mental Sea, as if encountering some long-lost old friend. A terrible guess arose in his heart—the Chen family's bloodline might originally be part of the Tianji Record.

Chen Nian's body could finally hold no longer, collapsing softly into Chen Ji's embrace. Her consciousness was fading, yet a smile still lingered at the corner of her mouth, as if having completed some long-held wish.

dialogue.content: Brother... don't leave me behind... this time... this time let me follow you...

text.content: Chen Ji tightly embraced his sister; the cracks finally appeared on his usually cold face. From that mouth that always calculated everything without exception came an extremely light sigh, like wind that had been suppressed for too long finally finding an outlet. The sword lights and sword shadows continued on the battlefield, but at this moment he only wanted to guard well this reunion bought with ten years of his sister's lifespan.

choice.prompt: The breath in Chen Nian's embrace grew weaker and weaker; Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Use Heavenly Fate to forcefully sustain life
choices.description: Consume 50 Heavenly Fate to forcefully stabilize Chen Nian's life force above the safety line
choices.risk_hint: Too low Heavenly Fate may affect future foresight ability

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate in the slightest; his fingers traced a complex rune in the air. Dark golden light surged from his Brow Center, transforming into a slender stream that poured into Chen Nian's chest. This was the most forbidden technique in the Tianji Record—to trade Heavenly Fate for life. He did not know what consequences this would bring, but he knew, without his sister, what use were those Heavenly Fate to him.

dialogue.content: (Low voice) Silly girl... your life is more important than anything.

choices.description: Use Shared Life buff to share consumption, preserving both
choices.visible_reward: May find a solution that benefits both
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may not be nearby

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze quickly scanning the battlefield. He was searching for that familiar figure—Su Qingyao, that Inner Disciple Senior Fellow with whom he shared a life connection. If he could get her involved, perhaps he could save Chen Nian without consuming too much Heavenly Fate.

choices.description: Awaken Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul within the Tianji Record and ask for his help
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's help often comes with greater mysteries

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking deep into the Mental Sea. On the first page of the Tianji Record, that hazy remnant soul was sleeping. He softly called out, informing Mo Xiansheng of Chen Nian's situation. Since he knew all the truths of the Tianji Record, he must know how to save her.

Sword lights and sword shadows raged on the battlefield, killing cries shook the heavens. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, protecting the unconscious Chen Nian in his embrace; his silhouette appeared especially lonely yet resolute amidst the chaotic battlefield. That talentless disciple ridiculed by all, at this moment held in his embrace the closest kin bought with his sister's ten years of lifespan.

dialogue.content: (Softly murmuring) Little Nian... when big brother finishes this game of chess, I'll take you home. In the future... big brother will protect you.

text.content: He lowered his head to look at the Turtle Shell Fragment in his palm; the ancient patterns flickered faintly within the dark golden light. The true source of the Chen family bloodline—this answer might unlock the ultimate secret of the Tianji Record. But now, he only wanted the girl in his arms to survive. Everything else could wait.

Just then, a凌厉 sword aura suddenly came from the distant battlefield. Chen Ji raised his head and saw a white-robed figure rapidly approaching—this was Su Qingyao. Her face carried an anxious expression, sword unsheathed in hand, cutting a bloody path for Chen Ji. Her gaze fell upon Chen Nian, her pupils contracting sharply, as if having realized something.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! What's wrong with her? Let me see!

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, only gently passed Chen Nian to Su Qingyao. His movements were extremely gentle, as if fearing to disturb his sister's dreams. That man who always calculated everything, at this moment had only naked worry and plea in his eyes. Su Qingyao took Chen Nian, her fingertips feeling her pulse, her brow creasing tighter and tighter.
Chen
